high_level_description: The image is a striking black-and-white poster with a series of close-up photographs of human eyes arranged vertically. Each eye is depicted in a different state, creating a sense of progression or transformation. The eyes appear to be from the same person, showing various expressions and states of alertness. At the top of the poster, there is red text that reads "IN THE BLINK OF." Below this, the next line says "AN EYE, EVERYTHING," followed by "CAN CHANGE WHEN" and finally "YOU LEAST EXPECT IT.
